mnemonic.meaning: 知 know + 恵 blessing: the blessing of knowing.
mnemonic.reading: "CHEE, AY!" (ちえ) Chie, the wise girl.

examples.ja: みんなで知恵を出し合った。
examples.en: We all pooled our ideas.

items.note: Practical wisdom, cleverness. 知識 (ちしき) is knowledge. 知恵を絞る = rack your brains.

mnemonic.meaning: 溺 has 氵 (water): weak (弱) in the water.
mnemonic.reading: "OBORE-RU!" (おぼれる) "Oh, bore!" you gasp, sinking.

examples.ja: 子供が川で溺れかけた。
examples.en: A child almost drowned in the river.

items.note: Also figurative: 酒に溺れる (drown in drink). It doesn't always mean dying.

mnemonic.meaning: 一 one + 家 house: one household.
mnemonic.reading: "IKKA!" (いっか) One car for the whole family.

examples.ja: 一家で海外に引っ越した。
examples.en: The whole family moved abroad.

items.note: 一家 = a household as a unit. 家族 = family members.

mnemonic.meaning: 情 has 忄 (heart): what the heart feels.
mnemonic.reading: "JOU!" (じょう) Same じょう as 感情 and 友情.

examples.ja: 長く飼っていた犬に情が移った。
examples.en: I grew attached to the dog I'd kept for so long.

items.note: Mostly in set phrases: 情が深い (warm-hearted), 情に厚い.

mnemonic.meaning: 企 plan + 業 business: a planned business.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, GYOU!" (きぎょう) The key to a business.

examples.ja: 大企業で働いている。
examples.en: I work for a big company.

items.note: 大企業 / 中小企業 (big / small and medium companies). 会社 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 急 sudden + 激 intense: suddenly and intensely.
mnemonic.reading: "KYUU, GEKI!" (きゅうげき) A cute geek suddenly jumps.

examples.ja: 気温が急激に下がった。
examples.en: The temperature dropped sharply.

items.note: Stronger and more sudden than 急速 (Level 12).

mnemonic.meaning: MOSHI (if) + KA + SURUTO: "if it were so...". Same as もしかしたら.

examples.ja: もしかすると、明日は雪かもしれない。
examples.en: It might snow tomorrow.

items.note: Usually ends in かもしれない. Same as もしかしたら, a touch more formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 機 machine + 関 relate: parts that connect to work.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, KAN!" (きかん) The key to the engine room. Same sound as 期間 (period).

examples.ja: 政府の機関で働いている。
examples.en: I work for a government agency.

items.note: 交通機関 = transport system, 報道機関 = the press, 機関車 = locomotive.

mnemonic.meaning: 上 above + 等 grade: an upper grade.
mnemonic.reading: "JOU, TOU!" (じょうとう) Joe's top quality.

examples.ja: 上等な肉を使っている。
examples.en: They use top-quality meat.

items.note: Slightly old-fashioned. In slang, 上等だ! means "bring it on!"

mnemonic.meaning: 物 things + 事 matters: things and matters.
mnemonic.reading: "MONO, GOTO!" (ものごと) All kinds of things.

examples.ja: 物事を前向きに考えよう。
examples.en: Let's think about things positively.

items.note: Things in general: 物事の順序 (the order of things).

mnemonic.meaning: 渦 has 氵 (water): water spinning.
mnemonic.reading: "UZU!" (うず) Ooze swirling down the drain.

examples.ja: 川に大きな渦ができていた。
examples.en: A big whirlpool had formed in the river.

items.note: 渦巻き = spiral, swirl.

mnemonic.meaning: 留 = to stay: make it stay in place.
mnemonic.reading: "TOMERU!" (とめる) Same sound as 止める (stop). You stop it from moving.

examples.ja: 紙をクリップで留めた。
examples.en: I fastened the papers with a clip.

items.note: 気に留める = to take notice. 止める (stop), 泊める (put up) are also とめる.

mnemonic.meaning: 考 think + 慮 consider: think it over carefully.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, RYO!" (こうりょ) Ryo considers his options.

examples.ja: 天気を考慮して予定を決めた。
examples.en: We made our plans taking the weather into account.

items.note: Formal. 考慮に入れる = to take into account.

mnemonic.meaning: GAKKARI: "Gah, car, ri-ally?!" Your car broke down. Disappointing.

examples.ja: 試合に負けて、がっかりした。
examples.en: I was disappointed to lose the match.

items.note: がっかりする is very common. 失望 (しつぼう) is a formal word.

mnemonic.meaning: 擦 has 扌 (hand): rubbing with the hand.
mnemonic.reading: "SURU!" (する) Same sound as する (do). You do the rubbing.

examples.ja: マッチを擦って火をつけた。
examples.en: I struck a match to light the fire.

items.note: Also read こする (to scrub). Usually in kana.

mnemonic.meaning: 猿 has 犭 (beast): an animal. A monkey.
mnemonic.reading: "SARU!" (さる) "Sir, oo!" said the monkey.

examples.ja: 猿も木から落ちる。
examples.en: Even monkeys fall from trees.

items.note: The proverb above means "even experts make mistakes".

mnemonic.meaning: 深 deep: make it deeper.
mnemonic.reading: "FUKA, MERU!" (ふかめる) Deep (深い) mail exchanges deepen a friendship.

examples.ja: 留学で日本への理解を深めた。
examples.en: Studying abroad deepened my understanding of Japan.

items.note: Transitive. 深まる (Level 16) = it deepens.

mnemonic.meaning: 広 wide: it becomes wide.
mnemonic.reading: "HIRO, MARU!" (ひろまる) Hiro's round news spreads widely.

examples.ja: その噂はすぐに町中に広まった。
examples.en: That rumour quickly spread through the whole town.

items.note: Intransitive (it spreads). 広める (Level 17) = you spread it.

mnemonic.meaning: 単 unit + 位 rank: a unit of rank.
mnemonic.reading: "TAN, EE!" (たんい) Tanned in units.

examples.ja: 卒業に必要な単位を取った。
examples.en: I got the credits I need to graduate.

items.note: Unit of measurement, or a university credit.

mnemonic.meaning: 剥 has 刂 (knife): peeling with a knife.
mnemonic.reading: "MUKU!" (むく) Same sound as 向く (face). You face the apple and peel it.

examples.ja: りんごの皮を剥いた。
examples.en: I peeled an apple.

items.note: Usually in kana: むく.

mnemonic.meaning: 枠 has 木 (wood): a wooden frame.
mnemonic.reading: "WAKU!" (わく) Wacky frame.

examples.ja: 予算の枠を超えないように。
examples.en: Don't go beyond the budget limit.

items.note: Also a slot or quota: 採用枠 (hiring quota). 枠を超える = go beyond the limits; 枠にとらわれない = think outside the box.

mnemonic.meaning: ZURERU: "Zoo-reru": the zoo map slipped out of place.

examples.ja: 写真が少しずれている。
examples.en: The picture is a little crooked.

items.note: Also for timing and ideas: 話がずれる (go off topic). ずれ = a gap.

mnemonic.meaning: 湿 has 氵 (water): moisture.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIMERU!" (しめる) Same sound as 閉める (close). Close the window or it'll get damp.

examples.ja: 洗濯物がまだ湿っている。
examples.en: The laundry is still damp.

items.note: Godan: 湿った. 湿気 (しっけ) = humidity.

mnemonic.meaning: 菓 sweets + 子 small thing: small sweet things.
mnemonic.reading: "KA, SHI!" (かし) Cash for sweets.

examples.ja: 子供にお菓子をあげた。
examples.en: I gave the child some sweets.

items.note: Usually お菓子. 和菓子 = Japanese sweets.

mnemonic.meaning: SORE + TOMO: "or else that one".

examples.ja: コーヒーにする?それとも紅茶?
examples.en: Would you like coffee? Or tea?

items.note: Only in questions, offering a choice. または is for statements.

mnemonic.meaning: 縄 has 糸 (thread): twisted thread. Rope.
mnemonic.reading: "NAWA!" (なわ) "Na, wa" a rope? 沖縄 has it too.

examples.ja: 縄で荷物をしばった。
examples.en: I tied the luggage with rope.

items.note: 縄跳び = skipping rope.

mnemonic.meaning: 気 spirit + 毒 poison: something that poisons your spirit to see.
mnemonic.reading: KI NO DOKU: "key, no doc!" Poor thing. (きのどく)

examples.ja: 事故に遭ったなんて、お気の毒に。
examples.en: I'm so sorry to hear you were in an accident.

items.note: Sympathy for someone else. お気の毒に = I'm sorry for you.

mnemonic.meaning: 区 divide + 別 separate: dividing and separating.
mnemonic.reading: "KOO, BETSU!" (くべつ) Cool, a separate bet.

examples.ja: 双子の区別がつかない。
examples.en: I can't tell the twins apart.

items.note: 区別がつく = can tell apart. 差別 (さべつ) means discrimination.

mnemonic.meaning: 財 wealth + 産 property: wealth and property.
mnemonic.reading: "ZAI, SAN!" (ざいさん) Mr. Zai's fortune.

examples.ja: 祖父は財産を寄付した。
examples.en: My grandfather donated his fortune.

items.note: Also figurative: 経験は財産だ (experience is an asset).

mnemonic.meaning: 予 beforehand + 算 calculate: calculating beforehand.
mnemonic.reading: "YO, SAN!" (よさん) Yo, Mr. Budget.

examples.ja: 旅行の予算は十万円だ。
examples.en: The budget for the trip is 100,000 yen.

items.note: 予算オーバー = over budget.
